regimes.HIGH_VOLATILITY: 15m ATR/close relative to preceding 64-value median >=1.5; breakout only, relative volume >=2
regimes.TRENDING: 1h ADX14 >=25 and nonzero EMA20/50 direction; pullback or breakout

rules.common: complete closed UTC candles, known current 1h, ATR>0, candle range <=3 ATR; stop distance 1.2 to 3 ATR with observed structure and 0.25 ATR buffer; expected net reward/risk >=1.2
rules.TREND_PULLBACK: 1h and 15m EMA direction agree; ADX15m>=20; previous candle touches EMA20/50 zone 0.25 ATR and current close breaks previous high/low by 0.05 ATR with directed body; RSI long 45..68 / short 32..55; relative volume>=0.8; no opposing confirmed HH/HL structure
rules.BREAKOUT: close beyond preceding 20-bar range by 0.1 ATR, or 0.2 in high volatility; range width<=6 ATR; volume>=1.5 or 2 in high volatility; ADX15m>=20; RSI long55..75/short25..45; no strong opposing 1h trend
rules.REVERSAL: RANGING only; preceding 8-bar RSI <=35 then current RSI40..60 and rising for LONG, mirrored >=65 then40..60 falling for SHORT; confirmed CHoCH+directed breakout at same close in preceding 8 bars plus current directed retest; relative volume>=1

validation_caveat: Chronological out-of-sample for frozen 4.3 rules, not an untouched historical holdout: parts of 2026 were examined in previous research.
